summary: Multi-country documents on investor citizenship and residence. New: the full text of Commission Recommendation C(2022) 2028, the Advocate General opinion in C-181/23, both EPRS studies (2018 and the 2021 added-value assessment behind the EP resolution), the 2023 FATF/OECD report, archived versions of the OECD CRS high-risk list showing how it shrank from 28 schemes (Oct 2018) to 22 (by Jan 2021), the TI/Global Witness "European Getaway" annex tables, the unrecorded rows of the Commission 2019 permit table, the Eastern Caribbean data table of the 7th visa-suspension report, and a Latvian Saeima inquiry-committee annex with investor-permit totals 2010-2016. Most figures are compilations (reported/estimate), not official outturns.

events.title: Commission asks member states to stop issuing investor residence permits to Russians and Belarusians
events.description: Recommendation C(2022) 2028, point 5: member states running investor residence schemes should suspend permits for Russian and Belarusian nationals; point 4: withdraw or refuse to renew permits of sanctioned persons; point 6: report by end of May 2022.
events.quote: Member States that operate investor residence schemes should suspend the issuance of residence permits on the basis of investor residence schemes to Russian and Belarusian nationals

events.title: Commission: naturalisations of sanctioned Russian and Belarusian investors should be reviewed

events.title: Advocate General Collins proposes dismissing the Commission's case against Malta
events.description: Opinion in C-181/23: the Commission had not shown that EU law requires a "genuine link" for naturalisation; the AG proposed dismissing the action with costs against the Commission. The Court ruled the other way on 29 April 2025. Primary source for event e-5222fda4f1 (dated 2024-10 from a secondary source).
events.quote: I propose that the Court: – dismiss the Commission’s action; – order the Commission to pay its costs and those of the Republic of Malta.

events.title: European Parliament research service publishes study on CBI/RBI schemes in the EU
events.description: EPRS study for the TAX3 committee estimating naturalisations, permits and investment in eight member states, and finding very little transparency.
events.quote: There is very little transparency over the number and origin of applicants, the number of citizenship or residency granted by CBI/RBI schemes

events.title: EPRS estimates 132,000 people and EUR 21.4 billion through EU investor schemes, 2011-2019

events.title: Transparency International and Global Witness report "European Getaway" on EU golden visas

events.quote: None of the countries, with the exception of Austria and Malta, publish lists of new citizens or residents.
